title: 15 Best Longevity Supplements in 2025 (Ranked by Evidence)
abstract: * A 2022 randomized clinical trial found that daily NMN supplementation significantly increased blood NAD+ levels in middle-aged adults within 30 days. * Long-term NMN supplementation has been shown to delay frailty, improve gut health by enhancing intestinal barrier function, and extend lifespan in aging mice.33 These benefits were linked to increased expression of proteins like SIRT1 and reduced inflammation. * A 12-week study involving older adults revealed that NMN supplementation reduced arterial stiffness and improved muscle performance metrics like gait speed and grip strength34, suggesting its potential for combating age-related vascular and muscular decline. * A 21-day study on older adults demonstrated that NR supplementation lowered markers of inflammation, suggesting its potential to mitigate age-related chronic diseases.39. * A 12-week randomized controlled trial showed curcumin supplementation (2000 mg/day) improved vascular endothelial function in middle-aged and older adults52, potentially reducing the risk of age-related cardiovascular diseases. By approaching supplements as one piece of a holistic health puzzle, you can optimize their potential benefits and support your body’s natural aging process more effectively.
